hooks.name: fixture-privacy-guard
hooks.description: On every agent save under gallery/** or in a test file/folder, refuses an unredacted trace: private (RFC 1918/4193), CGNAT (100.64.0.0/10), link-local or loopback addresses, access-network hops, or a source finer than country (privacy.md, VOY-N-13, VOY-P-04/P-16). Fixtures must use the documentation ranges (RFC 5737 / RFC 3849) or be fully redacted. Same logic as scripts/guards/fixture-privacy.guard.mjs in CI.
